items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: As Nene Strapania, I went on his job one night at the Moulin Rouge at the West End.

ctx.x: More like a string instrument. Yeah.

You think because of the snares or why do they call it a string? Not because it was a bass, I mean a bass drum in it or a drum, that it couldn't play soft. Yeah. You could use a drum just like you, and use it that you could hear all about the instrument. I go as to sign up a job on Audubon Street one day. And lady called me up. I goes up there to see her. And I mentioned to her about how many pieces I had in the band. And I began to call them out. When I say drums, she liked to jump out of her clothes. I said,…

How big a drum set do you usually have? Or did you like to use? What else did you use besides your snare drum and bass drum? And how many cymbals? I used two cymbals. And I got my set here. If you'd like to see it, I should. If it's not in trouble, you can just tell us about it. Maybe you'd not bother to get it out. Did you have a wood block?
